name: ASSURANCE
reviewNotes: No melody yet, on purpose: the last line ('all the day long') has a dotted quaver and semiquaver (in 9/8), which the half-beat solfa grid cannot show. The Open Hymnal score (The Lesser Hymnal, 1875) and the score on Wikipedia agree on it. Everything else fits: 9/8, a pickup of three quavers, doh D, opening m r d | s . . s . . f s l. Encode it once the grid can show quarter-beat notes.
